scope: selection-rule audit on one frozen block with existing checkpoints; no training, no algorithm ranking, no cross-state claim

selection.note: all rules rank the same k candidates with the same forecast bank and the same budget shield; 'feasible_forecast' is the rule that matches the research question, 'training_label' is what the critic was fitted on, 'forecast_ignoring_budget' keeps the old (inconsistent) oracle column only as a contrast

all rules rank the same k candidates with the same forecast bank and the same budget shield; 'feasible_forecast' is the rule that matches the research question, 'training_label' is what the critic was fitted on, 'forecast_ignoring_budget' keeps the old (inconsistent) oracle column only as a contrast

notes: 'training_label' is the exact quantity the critic was fitted on; 'feasible_forecast' is the study's actual target.
'forecast_ignoring_budget' reproduces the old oracle column and is not a like-for-like reference for the critic.
regret = best feasible predicted min EE - predicted min EE of the pick; negative values are possible for the old rule because it may pick an infeasible candidate with a higher raw min EE.
truth columns are validation only and never enter a decision.
a plain local search with the same evaluation budget is NOT included yet; until it is, 'learning vs search' cannot be attributed.
